svg.title: Firenze playable city layout blueprint v5 - expanded Florence shape and landmark-aware infrastructure review
svg.desc: Documentation-only Firenze playable city layout blueprint with expanded Florence-shaped boundary, Arno, B1-B3 bridges, 14 parcels, vegetation buffers, organic paths, five landmark anchors, QA badges and legend.
svg.text: Firenze playable city layout blueprint v5 - expanded Florence shape and landmark-aware infrastructure review
planning only | not runtime data | not asset | not engine ready | no app UI
Clean rule: spacious parcels, visible vegetation buffers, organic paths, landmark anchors, and Arno movement only via B1-B3.

g.text: QA: all Arno crossings use B1-B3
- PATH-N and PATH-S are organic spines.
- B1-B3 are the only Arno crossings.
- L1 Duomo / Santa Maria del Fiore.
- L4 Uffizi / art district; L5 Boboli/Pitti.
- Each parcel has main building zone.
- No YAML/JSON, no Flutter city entry
City Entry only after v5 review.
L1 Duomo / Santa Maria del Fiore
L3 Palazzo Vecchio / Piazza della Signoria
